title: GroundFall-US: open dataset of ground-failure incidents at U.S. mines, 2000 to 2026
description: GroundFall-US joins the U.S. Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) Accidents, Mines, and yearly Employment/Production files (2026-10-09 edition) into one documented dataset of ground-failure incidents at U.S. mines, 2000 to 2026: an incident table, injury rates per 200,000 hours by sector, mine type, commodity, and state, and a rule-based failure-mode layer (rockfall, raveling, planar, wedge, toppling, rotational slide; blasting, water, and scaling triggers) for surface metal and nonmetal narratives. Wall, bank, and slope stability is regulated under 30 CFR 56.3130. Code, codebook, limitations, and source fingerprints are included.
